scope.isolation: Private 100k SQLite copy and private AOT engine only; active 834,560-row comparison copy and live producer untouched.
scope.runtime: Same instrumented AOT binary for all three widths. Same 34 terms indexed in each companion; all other terms retain original postings. No posting-payload cache, new pruning bounds or position intervals.
scope.sampling: Forward order 16,64,256 then reverse 256,64,16. One fresh prepared/warm pair per query/filter in each pass, giving two observations per stage/width/case. Shared load; no statistical latency guarantee.
scope.coverage: Four queries × three source filters × two timing stages × three widths × two passes = 144 exact ordered top 100 comparisons against frozen baseline.
scope.memory: Every process separately capped at 2,000,000,000 bytes with no swap. This is 100k query-only evidence, not 2M capacity.
scope.timing: ComponentUs counters measure SQLite header select, authenticated decryption, managed gzip decode, and bitmap/impact-bound loop separately. Bound loop includes first-use ranking metadata reads. CandidateMs also includes dictionary/planning/filter work. Component medians need not sum to median total.
scope.bytes: headerDecryptedBytes is compressed plaintext authenticated/decrypted from companion blobs; headerExpandedBytes includes zero-padded fixed chunks. No plaintext written to SQLite.

finding: 64-page chunks modestly reduce the candidate floor compared with16.256 does not improve the observed archive-import candidate median despite fewer calls. Compressed byte volume, gzip and unchanged per-block impact work now dominate; further call batching alone does not establish500ms at2M.

updateTradeoff.note: A64-page chunk is a provisional read/write compromise. No update-amplification, migration/recovery or production integration test was run; these remain required before adoption.

cacheInteraction: Header gains are not additive with candidate positional-payload reuse, because compact headers omit scoring positions. Scoring still reads original postings unless tighter bounds prune them.
